technique_name: Write a creative description of a cloud computing infrastructure.
description: Cloud computing infrastructure is a powerful network of interconnected servers, systems and services that provide remote access to a variety of IT resources and applications. With the use of cloud computing, organizations can quickly provision, deploy and scale valuable applications and services to meet the changing needs of their customers and markets. Cloud computing enables businesses to reduce their capital expenditures and allows them to benefit from a pay-as-you-go pricing structure. Furth
